tasks.title: Envelope model, outcome/failure mapping, needs_human conversion and panic recovery
steps: Write the listed tests in internal/toolio (package toolio, test commands registered on an App with in-memory buffers) and confirm they fail

Create internal/toolio/envelope.go: Envelope struct with the PRD §2 fields in order and JSON tags, SchemaVersion="4.0.0", sub-structs (Input, NeedsHuman{Question,Options,Resume}, ErrorInfo, FixHint with omitempty flag/env/var/suggest, Warning, Artifact, SideEffect, Next, Usage), Status constants and ExitCode(Status) int; normalise nil slices to [] before marshalling

Create internal/toolio/failure.go: Failure{Category,Message,Retryable,FixHint} implementing error, the seven Category* constants (usage, auth, forge, io, cancelled, timeout, internal), and Outcome{Status,Summary,Result,NeedsHuman}

Create internal/toolio/app.go: App{Name,Version,Commit,BuildTime,NewForge,Now,Rand}, Command{Path,Summary,Usage,Flags,Run,...opt-in fields} and Run{Ctx,Tool,Argv,Dir,Input,Forge,Target,DryRun,Context,RunDir,Stderr} with Warn/Artifact/SideEffect/Next/Emit/SetUsage, App.Register and a minimal App.Main(ctx,args,stdin,stdout,stderr) int that matches a registered path exactly, parses a flag.FlagSet (ContinueOnError, output discarded) and calls the command (T2 refines dispatch and parsing)

Implement finish(): map outcome/error to status, error object, exit code (Failure usage->usage/2, other Failure->failed/1, plain error->failed/internal, retryable false), copy summary/result, default usage {brain "",cost_usd 0,cost_source none,0,0,0}, started_at/finished_at RFC 3339 UTC with milliseconds from App.Now, integer duration_ms

Implement needs_human conversion: options lettered A.. in order (max 26), options always [] not null, resume {argv: received args with argv[0] replaced by "af", flag "--context"}; reject needs_human with empty question, a question on another status, or >26 options as failed/internal with needs_human null

Recover panics in the command call: failed/internal envelope, stack written to stderr (and to <run_dir>/panic.txt when Run.RunDir is set, wired fully in the run directory task); stdout still holds exactly one envelope
Write the envelope with json.MarshalIndent (two spaces) plus one newline; ignore a stdout write error and return the status's exit code from Main

tasks.title: Command dispatch, flag parsing, help, version and --context
steps: Write the listed tests and confirm they fail

Dispatch: choose the longest registered command path matching the leading non-flag arguments; tool is that path; no args or an unknown first word gives a usage envelope with tool "af" and error.message listing every registered path (exit 2)

Per-command flag.FlagSet with ContinueOnError and io.Discard output; implement interspersed flags (flags before or after the positional), "--" ending flag parsing; a parse error or an extra positional (one allowed unless the command declares otherwise) becomes a usage envelope naming the flag/argument with nothing written to stderr

Register the global flags every command accepts: --output and --emit-events (stored on Run for later tasks), and opt-in flags only when the command declares them: --dir, --context (repeatable, values verbatim and ordered into Run.Context; an empty value is a usage error), --dry-run, --timeout, --repo (the flag registration only; behaviour comes in later tasks)
Plain-text help: -h, --help, `af help` and `af help <command>` print the command list or one command's synopsis and flags on stdout, exit 0, non-JSON

--version: print {name,version,commit,build_time,go_version} in that key order from App.Version/Commit/BuildTime, falling back to runtime/debug.ReadBuildInfo (main module version, vcs.revision, vcs.time), then version "dev" with empty commit/build_time; exit 0
Verify resume.argv keeps existing --context values so re-running it with `--context B` appended yields Run.Context [A,B] (TS-05-30) and that inconsistent outcomes are rejected (TS-05-33)

tasks.title: Summary normalisation, warnings, signals, timeouts and the needs_human envelope
steps: Write the listed tests and confirm they fail
Collapse any summary to one line (replace \n and \r with spaces) and fill a non-empty one-line summary whenever the shell sets the status (usage, internal, cancelled, timeout)
Run.Warn: dedupe on exact (code, message), keep first-raised order, never change the status

Install signal.NotifyContext for SIGINT and SIGTERM in Main; run the command in a goroutine; when the command returns an error after cancellation report failed/cancelled; if it has not returned 10 seconds after the signal, stop waiting and print failed/cancelled, exit 1 (make the grace period an App field so tests can shorten non-signal paths, but TS-05-25 uses the real 10s)

Opt-in --timeout flag: parse as time.Duration, negative or unparsable is a usage error before the command runs, use Command.DefaultTimeout when absent, 0 means no deadline, otherwise context.WithTimeout
On deadline expiry report failed/timeout, retryable false, fix_hint {flag "--timeout", suggest: twice the duration via time.Duration.String()}
Confirm a command that did not opt into --timeout rejects the flag as unknown (usage envelope)
Check the needs_human envelope for options A,B and the empty-options [] case (TS-05-29)

tasks.title: Positional input classification, truncation and the none/file/text/stdin forms
steps: Write the listed tests (TS-05-45 as a property test using testing/quick or a seeded generator) and confirm they fail

Create internal/toolio/input.go: SourceKind constants issue/file/text/stdin/none (KindIssue="issue"), Input{Kind,Origin,Body,Truncated,Issue *issuex.IssueRef,Thread *issuex.IssueThread}, and Resolve(ctx,arg,stdin,forge) (Input,error)

Classify in order: "-" reads stdin to EOF; issuex.ParseIssueURL accepts (kind issue; the thread read itself lands in the issue-reading task, leave a hook the forge task fills); http:// or https:// non-issue URL is a usage Failure naming the accepted GitHub issue/pull and GitLab issue/merge-request forms with fix_hint naming GITHUB_API_URL and GITLAB_API_URL; an existing regular file relative to the process cwd (kind file, origin absolute path; NUL in the first 8 KiB gives usage "not a text file"; a directory gives usage; an unreadable file gives failed/io); otherwise text trimmed
Missing positional on a command requiring input, or a body empty after trimming, is a usage error before the command runs

Truncate(body) cuts at the last UTF-8 boundary at or below 131072 bytes and appends "\n[... input truncated at 131072 bytes ...]\n"; set Input.Truncated and raise warning input_truncated; identity at or below the limit
Wire Command.Input (none/optional/required) into Main so Run.Input is set and the envelope input is {kind,origin,truncated} or {kind none, origin "", truncated false}
Do not read stdin or touch the filesystem for a command that declares no input

tasks.title: Forge client construction, --repo handling and client lifecycle
steps: Write the listed tests with an App.NewForge stub that records issuex.Options and returns a counting client, and confirm they fail
Default App.NewForge to issuex.NewWithOptions; build a client only for commands declaring UsesForge

Choose options: issue URL input gives Options{Repo: ref.Repo}; else with an opted-in --repo, parse via issuex.ParseRepo (invalid is a usage error) and use Options{Repo: parsed}; else Options{}; always set UserAgent "af/<version>" and Dir to the absolute --dir
If --repo and an issue URL name different repositories return a usage error before the command runs

If NewForge fails with issuex.ErrAmbiguousForge or ErrUnsupportedForge: for an issue URL input return a usage Failure carrying issuex's message with fix_hint {env GITHUB_API_URL}; otherwise hand the command issuex.NewNoOp() and an invalid Run.Target and still run it
Set Run.Target to the resolved repository (ref.Repo, parsed --repo, or client-detected where available)
Close the client exactly once when the command returns, errors or panics, before the envelope is written to stdout (defer inside the execution wrapper)
Ensure Run.Forge is nil and NewForge is not called for non-forge commands

tasks.title: DryRunForge decorator and --dry-run wiring
steps: Write the listed tests against httptest GitHub and GitLab servers (issuex.NewGitHub/NewGitLab with BaseURL and Token) counting requests by method, and confirm they fail
Create internal/toolio/dryrun.go: ErrDryRun sentinel and DryRunForge(inner issuex.Client) issuex.Client implementing every Client method

Pass through Authenticated, Close, GetRepository, ReadIssue, ListIssues, ListComments, ReadPullRequest, ReadChangedFiles, GetPRState, GetCIChecks, GetPRReviews; implement MaxBodyLength() int returning issuex.MaxBodyLength(inner)

For CreateIssue, UpdateIssue, CloseIssue, AddComment, AddLabels, RemoveLabel, CreateLabel, CreatePullRequest, PostReviewComment, MergePullRequest, ClosePullRequest send nothing, return an error wrapping ErrDryRun (fmt.Errorf with %w) and record {kind: snake_case method, target: IssueRef.String() or Repo.String(), state: planned} through a callback to Run.SideEffect, in call order

In the shell: when a command opts into --dry-run and it is given set Run.DryRun and hand it DryRunForge(inner); otherwise Run.DryRun false and the inner client; a command not opting in rejects --dry-run as an unknown flag
Make the decorator's recorder append to envelope side_effects; add compile-time assertion that the decorator implements issuex.Client and issuex.BodyLimiter

tasks.title: Issue and pull request input: RenderThread, thread reading and read errors
steps: Write the listed tests against httptest GitHub/GitLab forges (set GITHUB_API_URL/GITLAB_API_URL with t.Setenv, clear token variables) and confirm they fail

Implement RenderThread(ref issuex.IssueRef, t issuex.IssueThread) string: heading `<GitHub|GitLab|Forge> <issue|pull request> <ref> (state: <state>)` (host containing gitlab gives GitLab, containing github or empty gives GitHub, else Forge), Title:, Author:, Labels: (omitted when none), trimmed body, each comment as "
--- comment by <login> ---
<body>
", and "
[... further comments not read ...]
" when truncated

In Resolve, for an issue URL read the thread with the run's forge client via ReadIssue; set Input.Issue (IsPullRequest true when the URL or thread.Issue.IsPR says so), Input.Thread, Origin=IssueRef.URL(), Body=RenderThread before truncation
Set input.truncated and warn input_truncated when thread.Truncated; warn comments_unreadable when thread.CommentsErr is set and continue

Map read errors: IsNotFound with an unauthenticated client gives failed/auth (message says the issue may be private naming GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN or GITLAB_TOKEN, fix_hint env GITLAB_TOKEN for a GitLab host else GITHUB_TOKEN); IsNotFound authenticated gives failed/forge not retryable; rate limit or any other transport error gives failed/forge retryable true
Ensure the forge client is built before input resolution for an issue URL (order: parse arg, build forge, read thread) and that the cancelled-context case stays cancelled, not forge

tasks.title: Run directory, git-ignore file, OpenRunDir and the ledger
steps: Write the listed tests (TS-05-63 uses a real git repo and the git binary, t.Skip when git is absent; TS-05-65 is a property test) and confirm they fail

Create internal/toolio/rundir.go: RunDir{ID,Path} with NewRunDir(dir, now, rand) creating <abs dir>/.agent-fox/run/<id>/ where id is YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_<6 lowercase hex> from UTC time and App.Rand; on an existing directory draw a new suffix, 5 attempts in total, then failed/io
Create <dir>/.agent-fox/.gitignore with "*\n" via os.OpenFile with O_EXCL, treating os.IsExist as success (never overwrite, never touch the repository .gitignore)
OpenRunDir(dir, id): validate id against ^[0-9]{8}_[0-9]{6}_[0-9a-f]{6}$ (guards against traversal) and existence, otherwise a usage *Failure without touching the filesystem outside .agent-fox/run
Record(kind, data) appends {seq,ts,kind,data} lines to ledger.jsonl with seq 1..n; Ledger() reads them back in order; WriteReport(text) writes report.md

In Main: for commands declaring UsesRunDir, validate --dir exists and is a directory (usage error otherwise, before creating anything), create the run dir (also under --dry-run) before Run is called, set Run.RunDir, envelope run_id (null otherwise) and artifacts {run_dir,path} and {report,path} when WriteReport was called; paths absolute
Wire panic.txt for the panic path from task 1 now that a run directory exists
Confirm the shell itself records nothing in the ledger

tasks.title: Envelope copies, event stream and shell warning codes
steps: Write the listed tests and confirm they fail
Add the --output <path> and --emit-events <path> flags to every command's flag set

Create internal/toolio/events.go: event writer producing JSON lines {seq,ts,run_id,type,data} with seq from 1 and flush per line, writing to <run_dir>/events.jsonl and appending (O_APPEND|O_CREATE) to --emit-events; Run.Emit(type, data) for command events

Emit run_start {tool, argv, input_kind} first, one `warning` event per warning, and run_end {status, exit_code, duration_ms} last; when an event write fails raise warning events_unwritable exactly once and continue

Before printing, marshal the final envelope once and write identical bytes to <run_dir>/envelope.json and the --output path; failures add envelope_unwritable / output_unwritable warnings to the stdout envelope without changing status (re-marshal after adding warnings, then write the copies so all three stay byte-identical)
Define the warning codes as exported constants and check every code matches ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$ (TS-05-23 triggers input_truncated, comments_unreadable and the three unwritable codes)
A command without a run directory still honours --output and --emit-events

tasks.title: Schema, short-circuit precedence, cmd/af wiring and golden files
steps: Write the listed tests (golden comparison with a -update flag defined in each test package via flag.Bool) and confirm they fail

Create internal/toolio/schema/envelope.schema.json (draft 2020-12): every §2 field, schema_version const "4.0.0", required listing all fields in envelope order, result open, plus the $defs placeholder

Embed it with //go:embed in internal/toolio/schema.go; Command.ResultSchema json.RawMessage; `af --schema` prints the base schema with each registered command's result schema under $defs keyed by the path with spaces replaced by "_"; `af <command> --schema` narrows tool to const the path and result to null-or-the command's schema

Make --schema, --version and --help/-h take precedence anywhere on the command line, before input resolution, forge construction, stdin reads or run-directory creation (no .agent-fox directory, NewForge not called)

Create cmd/af/main.go: package main with var version, commit, buildTime string for ldflags, building toolio.App with them, registering no commands in this scope, and os.Exit(app.Main(ctx, os.Args, os.Stdin, os.Stdout, os.Stderr)); factor registration into a function testable without a subprocess
Write internal/toolio/testdata/schema.golden.json (no commands) and cmd/af/testdata/schema.golden.json (real registrations) by running the tests with -update, and commit them
Add the drift test: read Envelope's json tags by reflection and compare with the schema's required list in names and order, including a mutated-copy check that the comparison fails

tasks.title: make build writing bin/af, documentation and make doc
steps: Write the listed tests (TS-05-7 runs make build VERSION=9.9.9-test and bin/af --version, skipped when make is unavailable; TS-05-72 reads the doc files; TS-05-73 runs make lint and scans test sources for non-loopback URLs) and confirm they fail

Edit Makefile: keep `go build ./...` and add `go build -ldflags "-X main.version=$(VERSION) -X main.commit=$(COMMIT) -X main.buildTime=$(BUILD_TIME)" -o bin/af ./cmd/af` to the build target; do not edit .gitignore (bin/ already ignored)

Create docs/cli.md: af and global flags, the envelope field by field, the status and exit-code table (done 0, failed 1, usage 2, needs_human 3, unverified 4), the seven error categories, the warning codes input_truncated, comments_unreadable, envelope_unwritable, output_unwritable, events_unwritable, needs_human and --context, --dry-run, --schema/--version/help, run directory layout

Create docs/configuration.md (GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN, GITLAB_TOKEN, GITHUB_API_URL, GITLAB_API_URL and the .agent-fox directory) and docs/model-usage.md (af runs no model and reads no vendor key in this release)

Update docs/architecture.md: fill the run directory layout and ledger file formats item and remove the claim that docs/cli.md already exists; update README.md with cmd/af/, internal/toolio/ and bin/af
Run `make doc` and commit docs/generated/ including docs/generated/cmd/af.txt, then run make check
done_when: `make build` produces bin/af and `bin/af --version` reports the Makefile VERSION

tasks.title: Verify every execution path end to end through the real binary and shell
steps: Write the five smoke tests (cmd/af/smoke_test.go builds the binary with make build or go build -ldflags and executes it as a subprocess; internal/toolio/smoke_test.go drives App.Main with httptest forges, a temporary git checkout and a test command registered in the test) and confirm they pass
Trace 05-PATH-1 from cmd/af main through App.Main to the version and schema output; confirm each step calls the next and no stub remains

Trace 05-PATH-2 (resolver, forge construction, DryRunForge, run directory, events, envelope copies), 05-PATH-3 (needs_human resume with --context), 05-PATH-4 (unknown command) and 05-PATH-5 (unauthenticated GitLab merge request 404 giving failed/auth with GITLAB_TOKEN hint) through the real code

For each criterion with a contract confirm the producer's result is consumed by production code, not only by tests: Failure categories into the envelope, ErrDryRun side effects into side_effects, RunDir paths into artifacts, resume argv into needs_human, warnings into the envelope and events
Search every file in the tasks' touches (internal/toolio, cmd/af) for panic("not implemented"), TODO, and bare `return nil` on non-trivial paths, and remove any that remain
Confirm cmd/af/main.go calls toolio.App.Main from production code and that the real binary's --schema equals cmd/af/testdata/schema.golden.json
Run make check offline and confirm docs/generated is current
